misconceptions.defined-is-enough: Thought being defined at the point is enough. The value has to match the limit.
misconceptions.forgot-slope: Dropped the slope factor: |m(x − a)| = |m||x − a|.
misconceptions.forgot-to-subtract-L: Measured |f(x)| instead of the gap |f(x) − L|.
misconceptions.ignores-continuity: Applied the IVT to a function that isn't continuous on the interval.
misconceptions.ivt-converse: Read the IVT backwards: when it gives no guarantee, it doesn't say there's no solution.
misconceptions.ivt-without-between: Applied the IVT when the target isn't between the endpoint values.
misconceptions.misread-between: Missed that the target is between the endpoint values.
misconceptions.polynomial-discontinuous: Doubted that a polynomial is continuous. Polynomials are continuous everywhere.
misconceptions.sign-error: Mishandled a negative input (a negative number cubed stays negative).
misconceptions.slopes-must-match: Required matching slopes. That's differentiability; continuity only needs the pieces to meet.
misconceptions.swapped-ends: Swapped which endpoint gives which value.
